title: US-019 Generate a quote PDF from an opportunity
description: Romain stores the generated quote PDF on the batch and grants it to managers. It touches the same permission set as US-018, which is where the two collide.
commitMessage:
US-019 Generate a quote PDF from an opportunity

Adds Panel_Batch__c.Quote_Pdf_Url__c to hold the generated document,
granted on Helios_Delivery_Manager.
prTitle: US-019 Generate a quote PDF from an opportunity
prBody:
Sales rebuild the quote in a spreadsheet every time. This stores the generated PDF against the
panel batch so it can be linked from the opportunity.

- New field `Panel_Batch__c.Quote_Pdf_Url__c`
- `Helios_Delivery_Manager`: read and edit on the new field

Story: US-019 in BACKLOG.md
nextStep: Merge this one first: it is small and green. US-018 then has a permission set conflict to resolve, which is the point of Lab 3.4.
